title: bothriochloa saccharoides subvar. laguroides
intro: Bothriochloa saccharoides subvar. laguroides, commonly known as Black Needle Grass, is a type of grass native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and have potential anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of Black Needle Grass include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
